note: 20 CFR 404.2 (govinfo, the 2024-04-01 edition; last amended 85 FR 73156, 2020), read 2026-10-30: in the Social Security Administration's regulations under title II of the Social Security Act, 'State' includes the Commonwealth of the Northern Mariana Islands effective 1 January 1987, and 'United States' in a geographical sense includes it from the same date. POMS RS 03001.100 (TN 2, 04-01): the Northern Mariana Islands Social Security System merged with SSA on 1 January 1987. So its people hold the United States' Social Security number; the number's own terms are the United States file's.
